mentions.h: Surrey County x/c Championships - Report by Colin Pearson

photos.c: FRONT COVER: (Ed. Lacey) Tony Fairclough, one of Britain's leading juniors, fights his way past Graham (Windsor) in the Southern championships to finish 3rd. Two weeks later he was 5th in the 'National'.
The Saturday pack. Left to right: Tony Stone, John Davies, Bruce Webster, Mark Hutton, ?, Chris Taplin, Graham ?, Pam Davies, Charlie Henn, Mike Newton, Fred Riach
